recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Any future cleanup of broader mailbox terminology or unrelated $process-message editorial typos should be handled under their own Jira issues, not as a remaining FHIR-7976 application gap.
issue_request: FHIR-7976 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for the FHIR-core messaging page. It asked to add an option for a message receiver to send responses to a mailbox endpoint chosen by the source, with the accepted modification defining asynchronous $process-message use: async=true, an optional response-url defaulting to MessageHeader.source.endpoint/$process-message, immediate acceptance/error acknowledgement, and later response messages submitted to the chosen endpoint with async=true.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by svn revision 5657, mirrored as git commit 8b801ae887a7ed1c4e58cb57c30a8379b50cf157, whose subject explicitly names #7976 and #6343. That commit replaced the old mailbox messaging text with $process-message rules and added the async=true, default source endpoint, and response-url behavior. Later source restructuring moved the durable operation details into source/messageheader/operationdefinition-MessageHeader-process-message.xml.
additional_context: MessageHeader is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, its operations list references OperationDefinition/MessageHeader-process-message, and source/messaging.html links readers from the $process-message section to that operation definition. FHIR-6343 is the same implementation family because it converted the old mailbox endpoint into $process-message. Later response-message reconciliation commits for the same operation and messaging area refine HTTP/message-response wording but preserve the FHIR-7976 async response URL mechanism.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active OperationDefinition already defines the async and response-url input parameters and its operation text already states the default MessageHeader.source.endpoint/$process-message behavior, the alternative response-url behavior, and the requirement that response messages be submitted with async=true. Repeating those rules on source/messaging.html would be redundant because that page now intentionally delegates details to the active operation definition.

related_jiras.note: The same svn/git application commit used $process-message to replace the old mailbox endpoint model, providing the context for FHIR-7976's modified resolution.
A later $process-message reconciliation aligned response-message wording with zero-or-more responses while preserving the async response-url mechanism audited here.
